name: Arc de Triomphe
description: The Arc de Triomphe (Arc de Triomphe in Milan, Italy) is built of stone and looks like a gate tower. It has one or three arched openings and generally has a higher platform and parapet to give people a sense of stability, solemnity, and majesty. The reliefs on the rock wall and inside the arch are the most exciting parts of the Arc de Triomphe. Most of the content is the scene of the ruler leading his army back in triumph after winning the war.
